BiblicalUsage: The people complained that God did not see their fasting, while they exacted all their labours, and the word names the hired workmen they drove. It appears only here, in the fast God did not choose.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a fast that grinds the labourer is no fast at all, because God measures worship by mercy.
